mapper.select: /*getReqUserInfo*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER ) COM_NAME_LOC , A.ADD_DATE , A.SIGN_DATE , '지급' REQ_STATUS , '신청' PROCESS_STATUS , ADD_USER_NAME USER_NAME_LOC , ADD_USER_TEL PHONE_NUMBER , (SELECT MOBILE_PHONE FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID)MOBILE_PHONE , ADD_USER_ID FROM ICOMPRHD A WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{BUYER } AND A.PR_NO = #{PR_NO } AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND ROWNUM = 1

/*getReqDeptInfo*/ SELECT DEPT.TEXT1 HQ_DEPT_NAME , DEPT.TEXT4 HQ_ADDRESS , LUSR.LEGACY_USER_ID HQ_USER_ID , LUSR.PHONE_NUMBER , LUSR.USER_NAME_LOC HQ_NAME_LOC , LUSR.MOBILE_PHONE , LUSR.EMAIL HQ_EMAIL FROM ICOMCOD2 DEPT , ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE DEPT.TYPE = 'C001' AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = #{BUYER } AND LUSR.COM_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND LUSR.LEGACY_USER_ID = DEPT.TEXT3 AND LUSR.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND CODE = #{DEPARTMENT } AND ROWNUM = 1

/*getHqUserInfo*/ SELECT COMPANY_CODE BUYER , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = COMPANY_CODE) BUYER_NAME , TEXT1 DEPT_NAME , CODE DEPARTMENT , USER_NAME_LOC , USER_ID , LEGACY_USER_ID , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C003' AND CODE=LUSR.POSITION AND COMPANY_CODE = LUSR.COM_CODE)POSITION_NAME FROM ICOMCOD2 DEPT , ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE DEPT.TYPE = 'C001' AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE LIKE 'KRCOWA000%' AND LUSR.COM_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND LUSR.LEGACY_USER_ID = DEPT.TEXT3 AND LUSR.STATUS IN ('C', 'R')
AND TEXT1 LIKE '%'||#{DEPT_NAME }||'%'
AND CODE LIKE '%'||#{DEPTARTMENT }||'%'
AND USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{USER_NAME_LOC }||'%'
AND USER_ID LIKE '%'||#{USER_ID }||'%'
ORDER BY COMPANY_CODE , CODE , USER_ID

/*getOriPrInfo*/ SELECT A.BUYER , A.PR_NO , A.PR_SEQ , A.I_AFNAM , A.I_MBLNR , A.I_STATUS , A.BUKRS , A.ORGEH , A.STEXT , A.PERNR , A.ENAME , A.HDATE , A.ZGISU , A.NEWCK , A.ZCODE , A.MATNR , A.MAKTX , A.GIMENGE , A.MEINS , A.GUBUN , A.ERSDA , A.ERNAM , A.LAEDA , A.AENAM , A.YUMUSANG , A.DRSITE , A.DRCP , A.DPOINT , A.POST_CODE1 , A.CITY1 , A.STREET , A.TEL_NUMBER , A.MOB_NUMBER , A.REG_DATE , A.IF_DATE , A.IF_TIME , A.IF_FLAG , A.IF_MSG FROM EAI.IF_COWAY_PR_SEND A WHERE A.I_MBLNR = #{MBLNR } AND LPAD(A.MATNR, 18, '0') = #{MATNR }

/*getRecvUserInfo*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR(USER_ID, 3, LENGTH(USER_ID)) LEGACY_USER_ID , PHONE_NUMBER , USER_NAME_LOC , MOBILE_PHONE , EMAIL , USER_NAME_LOC||'/'||SUBSTR(USER_ID, 3, LENGTH(USER_ID))||'/기존/'||SUBSTR(BEGIN_DATE, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(BEGIN_DATE, 5, 2)||'-'||SUBSTR(BEGIN_DATE, 7, 2) DATA1 , 'N' DATA2 , '' DATA3 , '' DATA4 FROM ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE 1=1 AND COM_CODE = #{BUYER } AND DEPARTMENT = #{ORGEH } AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE LUSR.COM_CODE = COMPANY_CODE AND LUSR.DEPARTMENT = CODE AND FLAG = 'Y' ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C003' AND CODE = LUSR.POSITION AND COMPANY_CODE = LUSR.COM_CODE AND TEXT1 = '지국장' AND FLAG = 'Y' ) UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTR(USER_ID, 3, LENGTH(USER_ID)) LEGACY_USER_ID , PHONE_NUMBER , USER_NAME_LOC , MOBILE_PHONE , EMAIL , USER_NAME_LOC||'/'||SUBSTR(USER_ID, 3, LENGTH(USER_ID))||'/기존/'||SUBSTR(BEGIN_DATE, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(BEGIN_DATE, 5, 2)||'-'||SUBSTR(BEGIN_DATE, 7, 2) DATA1 , 'N' DATA2 , '' DATA3 , '' DATA4 FROM ICOMLUSR LUSR WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{ADD_USER_ID } ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

UPDATE COWAY_ZMM_GSYS_DE_RER_DISPLAY A SET (BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ) = (SELECT BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_COWAY_PR_SEND WHERE 1 = 1 AND I_MBLNR = A.MBLNR AND MATNR = TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(A.MATNR))) WHERE 1 = 1 AND SCREEN_ID = #{st_screen_id} AND USER_ID = #{st_user_id}

/*buyer.mdam.insertGsysDeliveryDisplaySum*/ INSERT INTO COWAY_ZMM_GSYS_DE_RER_DISPLAY ( SCREEN_ID, USER_ID, MBLNR, MATNR, MAKTX, GIMENGE, RQMENGE, RQCMENGE, SPEME, MEINS, BUKRS, ORGEH, STEXT, POST_CODE1, CITY1, STREET, TEL_NUMBER, MOB_NUMBER, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME ) VALUES ( #{SCREEN_ID}, #{USER_ID}, #{MBLNR}, #{MATNR}, #{MAKTX}, TRIM(#{GIMENGE}), TRIM(#{RQMENGE}), TRIM(#{RQCMENGE}), TRIM(#{SPEME}), #{MEINS}, #{BUKRS}, #{ORGEH}, #{STEXT}, #{POST_CODE1}, #{CITY1}, #{STREET}, #{TEL_NUMBER}, #{MOB_NUMBER}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') )
